catalog.title: POC seed: provisional 50-SKU medicine catalog
catalog.revision_note: Issue #30: POC-016 was replaced with metformin + sitagliptin 500 mg + 50 mg film-coated tablet (Janumet) to add an exact MDRP match (EO 104 s. 2020, row 44, MRP PHP 30.31). The former POC-016 metformin 850 mg record (Glucophage Forte) was removed.
catalog.scope: POC seed catalog for the Naga City price-comparison pilot. SKU basis is the 50-row PNF/Konsulta-anchored list in docs/research/05-naga-market-context.md section 4, with one MDRP-covered replacement under issue #30. Product-level references are from the FDA Verification Portal extract made on 2026-10-21.

notable_counts.note: PRD FR-6 and research note 05 state 32/50. A line-by-line check against Annex C (as of 30 March 2024) finds 33/50 after the issue #30 replacement; POC-016 is now an MDRP-covered metformin + sitagliptin SKU that is not Konsulta-listed. The one-SKU difference is flagged for reconciliation in the final-list ticket (#10).

caveats: Candidate generic alternatives are candidate groupings only. They are not a determination of therapeutic equivalence or interchangeability and require pharmacist review.
No price data were collected for this note. The "candidate cheapest-generic" label is provisional; price rank must be established during shelf-price collection.

Pack sizes are the FDA-registered commercial packs chosen as price-collection references. A pharmacy may sell a different pack or per unit; records must capture the actual pack and compute unit price.

FDA registration records are a point-in-time extract. The portal has no bulk API, rate-limits repeated queries, and the extract covers only products returned by the search terms used. Verify each product before launch.

Some classic originator brands (Renitec, Aquazide, Augmentin, Klacid, Bactrim, Macrodantin, Suprax, Vibramycin, Chlor-Trimeton) were not found in the FDA extract. Verified registered local brands were substituted as reference packs and are noted per SKU.
The 400 mg + 57 mg/5 mL co-amoxiclav suspension is PNF/Konsulta-listed but no FDA record was found in this pass; its reference product is recorded as unavailable.
Rx/OTC values follow the FDA classification field. "Household Remedy (HR)" products are recorded as OTC-family products, not as prescription drugs.
